Banks to remain closed on September 18 due to holiday

Banks across India will remain closed on Friday, September 18, on account of a holiday declared by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The holiday is observed in Meghalaya. While the specific reason for the holiday was not detailed in all reports, it is linked to a regional observance.
